title: A core's brief spike holds no launch: master status shows the 60 s package average
description: GY-3426: with a fixture hwmon whose core sensor spikes to 99C for one reading while the package stays near 61C, a minute of loop cycles leaves master status showing the averaged package temperature (61C), the full trial cap and no launches waiting — where the GY-3416 guard compared the instant spike to the limit and held every launch.

steps.name: master status shows the averaged package temperature and no launches waiting
